title: Capsule Protocol Policy and Registry Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, HTTP/3 package build, diff hygiene, and broad-suite instability checks for the RFC 9297 Capsule Protocol policy surface.
scope: This verification covers Capsule Protocol response status preconditions, no-content constraints, HTTP/3 CONNECT-only use, malformed-message mapping, Capsule-Protocol structured-field Boolean parsing, false/non-Boolean absence behavior, unknown parameter ignoring, intermediary processing, recommended emission, Capsule-Protocol field-name registration, Capsule Type registration labels, and reserved Capsule Type values.
preconditions: The RFC 9297 foundation slice exists as `ARC-QUIC-RFC9297-0001`, `WI-QUIC-RFC9297-0001`, and `VER-QUIC-RFC9297-0001`.
The HTTP/3 policy helper lives in `src/Incursa.Quic.Http3`.
expected_result: The focused RFC 9297 policy tests pass, the HTTP/3 package builds, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9297 policy artifacts, generated triage reflects the policy slice as trace-clean, and diff hygiene passes.
status_summary: The RFC 9297 Capsule Protocol response/header policy and registry invariants are trace-owned and verified by focused local gates. Runtime stream lifecycle, flow-control deadlock policy, type-specific Capsule payload validation, HTTP/1.x start policy, and intermediary DATAGRAM Capsule conversion remain future RFC 9297 slices.
